fusions.name: Hoofbeat Surge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and strike it for 15 damage, up to 1.4 times as much from your full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampede of Spray
fusions.desc: Thunders a wave forward in a cone 6 tiles long, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to everything in it and leaving each [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Canter
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Heart Keeps Time
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%. It also regenerates 0.4 health a second, permanently.
